classification: Human; Demon Slayer; Hashira; Serpent Hashira
summary: Obanai Iguro awakened the Demon Slayer Mark during the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji. The mark dramatically increased his physical abilities, allowing him to cut through Muzan's attacks and repeatedly damage his body alongside the other Demon Slayers. Obanai's Transparent World and Kaburamaru further enhanced his ability to predict and respond to Muzan's movements.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

notes: Obanai's Demon Slayer Mark greatly amplifies his physical abilities. He was able to cut Muzan's arm whips and slash his neck multiple times. He also possesses the Transparent World and can use Kaburamaru to guide his attacks when blinded. His Bright Red Nichirin Sword provides a further amp but is not treated as a separate variant here.
